full_judgment: Md Zakir Hossain, J: At the instance of the petitioner, this Rule Nisi was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why a direction upon the respondent No. 5 to execute a registered deed of the schedule land, District= Dhaka along with Sadar Sub-Register, former Police Station-Tejgoan, at present Police Station-Sabojbugh, Taji No. 1575, Mouza-Nondipara, JL No. 123, CS Khatian No. 677, SA Khatian No. 982, RS Khatian No. 678, CS Plot No. 809, BS Dag No. 8761 land measuring 24 decimals/0.24 Ajutangsho to the petitioners name as highest Tender Bidder in the light of the application to the respondent No. 5 (Annexure-E) to the petition and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper.
